# House in Greece for Sale

Rebuild of the official single-property listing website for George Xipolitas's penthouse apartment in Thessaloniki, Greece. Fully optimized for Golden Visa and property investment queries.

- **URL**: https://houseingreece.forsale
- **Property Location**: 1B Elenis Skoura Str., N. Elvetia, Thessaloniki, 54249, Greece
- **Owner/Landlord**: George (Yiorgos) Xipolitas
- **Contact Number**: +30 6974 269889
- **Email**: contact@houseingreece.forsale

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://houseingreece.forsale/): Property features, specifications, kitchen details, neighborhood guides, transit times, and direct contact forms.
- [Why am I Selling my house](https://houseingreece.forsale/why-am-i-selling-my-house): Narrative by landlord George and details about his pre-aligned expert transaction team (lawyers, accountant, engineer, banking links).
- [Gallery](https://houseingreece.forsale/gallery): Categorized photo galleries of the living room, kitchen, bedrooms, bathroom, balconies, building exterior, and layout plan.
- [Kit for Professionals](https://houseingreece.forsale/kit-for-real-estate-agents): Access page for real estate agents and brokers to download layout plans and media packs.
- [Lets Communicate](https://houseingreece.forsale/lets-communicate): Detailed contact details and instant messaging portals (Viber, WhatsApp, Skype, FB Messenger).

## Key Investment Articles
- [12 Reasons to Invest on House in Greece](https://houseingreece.forsale/blog/here-are-12-reasons-why-you-should-invest-on-house-in-greece): Why buying this penthouse is a premium yield opportunity.
- [Thessaloniki Investment Hub](https://houseingreece.forsale/blog/greece-is-the-next-big-thing-in-investment-with-thessaloniki-leading-the-way): Big tech investments (Microsoft, Amazon, Pfizer, Cisco) driving property value in Thessaloniki.
- [Let's Grow Together in Greece](https://houseingreece.forsale/blog/greece-tales-of-investment-opportunities): Multinational and institutional expansion in real estate and tourism.
- [Golden Visa Residency Concessions](https://houseingreece.forsale/blog/stay-golden-only-in-greece): Full breakdown of EU visa benefits, Schengen travel, and family residency.
- [ Booming Real Estate Market](https://houseingreece.forsale/blog/the-best-investment-on-earth-is-earth-in-greece): Record inflows and Israeli/foreign real estate developer interest in Greece.
